title: After the clip
teaser: Watch a short clip, sit with it for a moment, then answer what you remember seeing.

watch.prompt: Play the clip once. Notice what is actually on screen — not what you expect to see.

payload.heading: A short clip
payload.credit: CC0 sample clip (MDN interactive examples). Placeholder until an original IsItFR Memory video is produced — not NASA or news footage.

wait.prompt: Don't replay the clip. Let the picture settle before the questions.

color.prompt: In the clip you just watched, what color were the petals?

options.label: Pink to magenta — a single bloom against a dark backdrop
Bright yellow, like a sunflower filling the frame
One flower opens in close-up; the camera stays on that bloom
A bee crawls into the flower, then the shot cuts to a whole garden

done.prompt: That's the end of this short run.
